question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2:** '**depends**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence requires the present tense form of the verb to indicate an ongoing condition that affects the standard of living.
 
• "Depends" is the correct present tense form that fits grammatically in the context of the sentence.
 
• Other options ("depended", "depending", and "dependent") do not fit correctly within the sentence structure.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.
